flows.title: Change a short link's slug
steps: Click the icon next to the link for which you want to edit the slug; it opens the Basic link editing screen.
In the Basic link editing screen enter a new slug in the Link slug field, or select one from the AI-generated options.
Short.io slugs are unique, so you cannot have two or more with the same name. Using case-sensitive slugs is a way to avoid this restriction.
